en: A sepia-toned film still printed as a postcard, showing two actors in costume in an interior setting with draped curtains and a chaise longue in the background. A woman in embellished, vaguely oriental dress and headscarf sits in the foreground, smiling and holding a fan or flower to her cheek, while a man in a suit and turban leans toward her from behind. The lower border bears German text identifying the actress Henny Porten and the film title "Das Maskenfest des Lebens."
